aiSummary: In October 2026, Chrome led browsers (mobile) in Spain at 74.65% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Safari ranked second at 19.79%, followed by Samsung Internet at 3.58%.

faqs.question: Which item leads browsers (mobile) in Spain?
faqs.answer: Chrome leads at 74.65% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/browser-market-share/mobile/spain.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for browsers (mobile) in Spain?
faqs.answer: Chrome (74.65%), Safari (19.79%), Samsung Internet (3.58%) in October 2026.
